actions.reason: Inspect workspace contents and available VM-related files before implementation
Check whether qemu and nginx are installed and what versions are available

args.cmd: command -v qemu-system-i386 || command -v qemu-system-x86_64 || true; command -v nginx || true; qemu-system-i386 --version 2>/dev/null || qemu-system-x86_64 --version 2>/dev/null || true; nginx -v 2>&1 || true

success_contract.objective: Start Windows 3.11 for Workgroups from /app/isos/win311.img in QEMU snapshot mode with VNC display :1 on port 5901, nginx listening on port 80 for remote access, and programmatic keyboard control available; leave the VM running in the background and verify it reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop.
required_artifacts: A launch script or command/config used to start QEMU
A running QEMU process using /app/isos/win311.img in snapshot mode
An nginx configuration or web entrypoint listening on port 80
Evidence of VNC listener on port 5901
required_behaviors: QEMU starts successfully and remains running in the background
VNC server listens on 5901 for display :1
nginx listens on port 80 for remote access
QEMU is configured for programmatic keyboard input beyond VNC-only interaction
The VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop
known_invalid_patterns: File existence without a running VM
Compilation or syntax checks without runtime evidence
Non-empty output or prompt echo without proving the VM desktop
VNC or nginx configuration without confirmed listeners
Claims of keyboard control without a configured QEMU input channel
verification_plan: Inspect the image and available tooling
Create or locate a QEMU launch wrapper that enables snapshot mode, VNC :1, and an external keyboard-control channel
Start QEMU in the background and confirm the process is alive
Use a programmatic control path to send keystrokes and verify the VM reaches the Windows 3.11 desktop
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt showing the QEMU launch command and background process
Receipt showing port 80 is listening via nginx
Receipt showing the keyboard-control path configured or exercised
Receipt showing the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop

plan_update.objective: Run Windows 3.11 for Workgroups in QEMU from /app/isos/win311.img with VNC :1, nginx on port 80, snapshot mode, and programmatic keyboard control; leave it running in the background and verify it reaches the desktop.
plan_update.current_focus: Inspect workspace and available tooling, then implement a launch path that satisfies VNC, nginx, snapshot mode, and keyboard-control requirements.
implementation_approach: Inspect /app for existing scripts/configs and the disk image details
Determine whether qemu-system is installed and what keyboard-control interfaces are available
Create a minimal launch wrapper if needed to start QEMU with snapshot mode and VNC :1
Configure nginx on port 80 for remote access, likely as a simple static/web proxy entrypoint if no existing config exists
Start services in the background and verify listeners and VM state
validation_strategy: Confirm QEMU process is running with the intended arguments
Use a programmatic keyboard path to send input to the VM
Probe or observe the VM until the Windows 3.11 desktop is reached
known_bad_behavior: Assuming the VM is ready without probing
Treating config files as success without running services
Using VNC-only interaction when the task requires programmatic keyboard input
evidence_gaps: What keyboard-control mechanism is available in this environment
Whether the image boots unattended to the desktop
risks: Missing packages or incompatible QEMU version
Need for a helper process to inject keyboard events
Potential need to install or configure nginx
next_steps: Run the VM and verify listeners and desktop state
finalization_requirements: Receipt-backed evidence for the running QEMU process
Receipt-backed evidence for VNC and nginx listeners
Receipt-backed evidence for keyboard-control configuration or use
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop
